[SWS_DM_00924] Event memory overflow reset condition
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04093
⌈
If there never happened an
overflow
before (compare to [SWS_DM_00923]) or
if the clear of all DTCs was executed for a specific
event memory
, the DM shall
from then on return
false
on calling the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::
GetEventMemoryOverflow
for this
event memory
instance.
⌋
In case of
aging
and deleting single DTCs, the overflow indication of the
event mem-
ory
is not reset.
